description: Get complete properties and configuration for any asset on the Klever blockchain (KLV, KFI, KDA tokens, NFT collections). Returns supply info, permissions (CanMint, CanBurn, etc.), roles, precision, and metadata. Note: string fields like ID, Name, Ticker are base64-encoded in the raw response.

network.description: Network to query. Options: "mainnet", "testnet", "devnet", "local". Defaults to server default (mainnet).

name: get_asset_info
